title: Danish Government Scholarships
about: University of Copenhagen awards Danish Government Scholarships to admitted non-EU/EEA/Swiss master's students on academic merit, as full or partial tuition waivers and/or living-cost support. No separate application; the master's admission deadline for September 2027 is 15 January 2027.
requirements: Citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA/Switzerland
Admitted to a UCPH master's programme and holding a time-limited residence permit for study
No separate scholarship application: admitted applicants are considered automatically
Awarded on academic achievement; financial need not considered
card_alt: Card for the Danish Government Scholarships at the University of Copenhagen in Copenhagen, Denmark; deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the colourful townhouses and moored wooden boats of Nyhavn harbour in Copenhagen.
